purpose_context: apm-go plugin init scaffolds plugin.json but nothing checks a hand-edited manifest until Claude Code fails to load it. This mission adds apm-go plugin validate: a read-only check of the manifest against the official Claude Code plugin schema and reference (required name, field types, path-field syntax, unrecognized fields as warnings, --strict for CI), closing the second half of issue #13.
purpose_tldr: Let plugin authors and CI confirm a plugin.json will be accepted by Claude Code before packing or publishing.
